verticalFaqs.question: Does Chiefy handle weather cancellations and cruise ship schedule changes?
verticalFaqs.answer: Yes. When you cancel a tour due to weather or a cruise ship arrival time shifts, you can tell Chiefy once and it drafts personalized reschedule or update emails for every affected guest. No more copying and pasting the same message 30 times. Each reply includes the guest's original booking details and available alternatives.

verticalFaqs.question: We get the same questions constantly — 'will we see whales?', 'what should I wear?', 'is it okay for kids?' Can Chiefy handle those?
verticalFaqs.answer: That's exactly where Chiefy shines. It learns your standard answers — species you typically see, what to bring, age policies, seasickness tips, departure times — and drafts complete replies instantly. You review and send. Most captains tell us 80% of their inbox is the same 10 questions, and Chiefy handles all of them.
